reason: I like the creator, but I've never heard of Claro and $68 up front plus a subscription is a lot to bet on a brand that could be a rebadged generic bottle. My gym has a filtered fountain already, so I'd hold off and see if anyone else I follow is still using it in a month.
objection: No track record and no reviews I can see. 'The supplier rates it at 150 L' tells me nothing about who actually makes the filter or whether it does anything my gym's fountain doesn't, and 5% off doesn't make up for that.
would_change_my_mind: Independent lab test results for the filter and a no-questions return on the bottle, or seeing the creator still using it on camera a couple of months later rather than just in one sponsored post.
